description: This PHP file defines the ShippingMethod class within the Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout namespace. It provides functionality to retrieve available shipping methods based on the provided shipping address, interacting with extensions and configurations in the Opencart system.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Represents a checkout shipping method, capable of retrieving available shipping options based on address data.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods for a given address, loading relevant extensions and sorting the results by sort order.
